# obot_mcp_tunnel (Data Source)

Reads one MCP tunnel definition by its generated ID. Errors if it does not exist. Returns a preview only; creating or explicitly rotating a managed tunnel is required to capture a complete token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "tunnel_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Generated Obot tunnel ID to look up."
}

data "obot_mcp_tunnel" "existing" {
  id = var.tunnel_id
}

# Metadata and token_preview are available. Complete tokens cannot be read.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Generated Obot tunnel ID to look up. Display names are not unique identifiers.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_urls` (Set of String) Permitted target URL or hostname patterns. An empty set denies all targets.
- `description` (String) Description of the tunnel's purpose.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable tunnel display name.
- `token_preview` (String) Non-secret shortened preview. The complete token cannot be read from Obot.
